summary.text: May Nivar is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 57th District, which covers part of Goochland County and part of Henrico County, and has served since January 14, 2026.
Nivar sits on the House committees on Counties, Cities and Towns and Labor and Commerce.

paragraphs.text: May Nivar was born in Philadelphia, PA, according to the House profile.

The profile lists Nivar's education as New York University (B.A., Journalism, 1993), along with the APAICS National Leadership Academy (2024), the Sorensen Political Leaders Program (2023) and Leadership Metro Richmond (2017).
The profile gives Nivar's occupation as corporate social responsibility.

Nivar's listed memberships and affiliations include Henrico County Democratic Committee; Goochland County Democratic Committee; Virginia Center for Inclusive Communities State Board & Richmond Chapter; OCA Central Virginia Chapter; Asian and Latino Solidarity Alliance; Governor's Virginia Asian Advisory Board 2017-2021.
